title: Executive daily priorities  Ana Morales  2026-03-13
content:
Top priorities (today)
1) Acme Corp sales demo (11:00)  ensure Dedicated offering answers for data residency + SLAs. Key asks: monthly throughput SLA, burst policy, KMS integration. Prep notes: demo env on d3-gpu, use model-x-quantized-8.
2) SOC 2 readiness sync with Legal (14:30)  collect outstanding evidence, confirm log retention policy and Private deployment checklist. Action: give Legal list of Dedicated customers that will require SOC 2 addendum (Priya to confirm list).
3) Infra cost review (15:30)  look at root cause of last week's GPU overprovisioning spike, propose 1-2 immediate mitigations (burst cap, scale-in policy). Ask SRE for telemetry slice.
4) Model onboarding gating doc (ASAP)  finalize rollout checklist for new open-models (perf profile, quantization guidance, compat matrix). Need input from Applied ML by EOD.
5) People: finalize candidate score for VP of Product before 18:00. 2 references pending (Ravi).

Meeting prep / talking points
- Acme demo: open with latency & cost numbers vs. their current provider; show Dedicated reliability story; be explicit about migration plan + pilot timeline (30 days).
- SOC 2: highlight Private deployment options and audit trail (KMS/HSM + console audit logs). Ask legal which artifacts need vendor attestation.
- Infra cost review: present 3-month showing of GPU utilization, cost per token for top 5 customers, and proposed throttling tiers.

Follow-ups & notes
- Follow up with Applied ML: need final perf bench for model-x by 17:00  JIRA INF-2731.
- Priya: confirm list of Dedicated customers needing SOC 2 addendum (blocked until she checks with account leads).
- Ravi: reference check #2 for VP product  aim to close before candidate loop next week.
- Engineering: short-term mitigation to avoid overprovisioning: 1) tighten autoscaler cooldown; 2) emergency cap on reserved pools. Ask SRE to turn on cap for one day to measure behavior.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Do we push new rollout policy that defaults to quantized models for non-enterprise hosts? Pros: cost. Cons: potential regressions on instruction-following. Need product + applied ML decision by Friday.
- Pricing: consider a "burst add-on" for Dedicated to capture customers who want occasional > committed capacity. Ask Finance for modeling.

Today timeline (rough)
- 09:00 quick stand w/ EA (calendar review, prep deck)
- 10:00 1:1 with Priya (30m)  SOC 2 action items
- 11:00 Acme demo (45m)
- 12:30 lunch
- 14:30 SOC 2 sync (legal)
- 15:30 Infra cost review (SRE + Finance)
- 17:00 candidate gating review

Tomorrow / short-term
- Finish the model onboarding gating doc and publish to Confluence; link to perf profiles and recommended quantization settings.
- Draft partner one-pager for SI partners describing Dedicated + Private handoff process.

Quick links
- Okrs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Quarterly+OKRs
- JIRA: INF-2731, INF-2456
- PR infra cost dashboard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342

Notes to self (scratch)
- Keep demo simple: 3 slides + live demo. Avoid deep infra details unless asked.
- If Acme asks about model drift / quality: show rollback + canary flow + eval sets used for regressions.
- Remind product team about weekly eval regression emails (automate this).


(Quick status: feeling pressured by SOC 2 timeline; need Priya and Legal alignment today or push the public-facing Pilot to next week.)
